THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Janaka Bandara Thennakoon, Minister of Lands and LandDevelopment hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed fora public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of thatAct.

An allotment of land in total extent of about 3.1363 Hectares,depicted in the Advance Tracing No. MU/PTK/2014/191 dated of24.07.2014 prepared by the Superintendent of Surveys KilinochchiDistrict, situated in the Village called Putukkudiyiruppu in the GramaNiladhari Division, No. Mul/36 Putukkudiyiruppu East, in theDivisional Secretary's Division of Putukkudiyiruppu of MullaittivuDistrict in Northern Province and bounded as follows.

01. Lot ‘A’ – Putukkudiyiruppu Kani – Extent: 3.1363HectaresNorth: Road (R.D.A) and Putukkudiyiruppu Kani, claimed Notknown; East: Road (P.S); South: Parth; West: Parth andPutukkudiyiruppu Kani, claimant not known.
Janaka Bandara Thennakoon,Minister of Lands and Land Development.
My. Reference No.: 4/3/4/2013/D/250.D/S. Ref. No.: LLD/DO/(J)LA/CH/06.Ministry of Lands and Land Development,No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.27th November, 2014.
